hints.title: Check-In and Route Aggregation Maps
hints.text: Store ongoing passenger journeys keyed by customer identifier, and aggregate total travel duration and trip count between station pairs.

hints.title: Station Pair Route Keying
hints.text: Use composite string key (startStation, endStation) to accumulate cumulative travel time and completed trip count.

hints.title: Check-Out and Average Computation Blueprint
hints.text: On checkOut, pop (startStation, t_in) from customer map, add (t_out - t_in) to route map, and increment trips. getAverageTime returns total / trips.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(1) checkIn, O(1) checkOut, O(1) getAverageTime
complexity.notes: All operations execute in constant time via hash map lookups and running sums.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning historical journey logs on each average query leads to O(T) search time per request.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual map architecture maintains active journeys and cumulative route totals simultaneously.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: O(1) average time query using incremental running sum and trip counter.
